## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [善熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%86%B9) Shànxī is a polemical-critical compilation against errors in rival Buddhist commentarial traditions. The genre — *biàn fēi* "discriminating errors" — is one of the standard formats of Sòng-period Buddhist polemical literature, and Shànxī's contribution is part of his broader engagement with rival Buddhist doctrinal positions, paralleling his *[Píng jīn gāng pī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0137)* (X1018).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1170 – 1200) reflects [善熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%86%B9) Shànxī's mature scholarly activity. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1019) collection.
